# Laws of one step at a finer unit

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> The exact conditions of coming and ceasing to stand, a rise given to, a fall taken from, and arising needing an active giver hold at every resolution. The law of one exchange holds with change read in the unit, not raw counts; law 1's recurrence and law 3's bound need refinement counted as giving.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Read the unit as splitting into r t finer units across the step from t (Flow.BalancesAt of Becoming.Resolution), with balance made local to a family and a step (Flow.BalancesAtOn), and read change in the unit: a condition rises where its level after the step exceeds r t times its level before (Web.RisesAt), and falls where it is below (Web.FallsAt); with r constantly one each is the original notion (Flow.balancesAtOn_one, Web.risesAt_one, Web.fallsAt_one, Flow.runsDownOnAt_one). With no condition on r: with balance at a condition at that resolution, it comes to stand exactly when it stood at nothing and was given more than was taken from it, and ceases to stand exactly when it stood and what was taken from it is all it had in the finer unit with all it was given (Flow.BalancesAtOn.comesToStand_iff, ceasesToStand_iff); a rise in the unit is given to and a fall taken from (rise_given, fall_taken); where nothing is taken from the family, a member rises in the unit exactly when something taking part gives to it (rises_iff_gives), which dissipation on the family excludes (Flow.DissipatesOn.still_untaken_at); an embodied relatum arises only as an active giver other than itself gives to it (arises_given); nothing comes to stand from nothing (comes_from_standing). One exchange: across a step at which a family holding what stands without repetition is balanced at that resolution and dissipated on (Flow.RunsDownOnAt), some condition rises or falls in the unit exactly when the family's total after the step is below r t times its total before (Flow.RunsDownOnAt.changes_iff). Read in raw counts it fails: with the unit splitting in two and nothing exchanged every level doubles, every condition rises in raw counts, and nothing changes in the unit, the total not falling (Doubling.raw_reading_fails). Need is read in the unit of the level (a reading): with the unit splitting into r t > 0, a formation whose requirements stay and whose needs and required levels are read in the finer unit is supported after the step exactly when before (Web.supported_unchanged_by_split); needs compared across steps are read through the unit factor (unitFactor, continuing_restores_in_unit, consumed_continues_transformed_in_unit, inactive_below_in_unit); a rise in the unit is given by a supported formation (Flow.BalancesAtOn.rise_given_by_supported). The laws counting a loss over a stretch need a fixed unit: with the unit doubling at every step and nothing giving, a formation taking one finer unit at every step is active and supported forever (Feeding.endless), fed by the refinement.

Canonical source: [Units.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Units.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No global premise: the condition of each law is stated inside it, at the step and family used. No condition on the refinement r.
- Representation: change is read in the unit (Web.RisesAt, Web.FallsAt), a commitment of the representation (how change is measured), not a premise on worlds.

The zero-premise plan lists whole units as a commitment of the representation (Ren's item 4) and asks which laws survive amounts finer than them. This result answers for the laws of one step: law 4 and coming and ceasing to stand hold at every resolution; law 1's one exchange holds with change read in the unit. It tests a commitment of the representation: what it finds is that change must be measured in the unit, not that the law fails.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 31 theorems of the new core module Becoming.Units all have empty axiom reports; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. It was first compiled from the prelude in a scratch tree, with no warnings and every #print axioms empty. The core closure is 49 modules, every source declaration in it with an empty axiom report, compiling from Lean's prelude alone. There is no independent review yet; the author's counterreview is in §81 of the integration note.

The recurrence of law 1 and the bound of law 3 use the least difference in a fixed unit: at a refining unit they fail where the refinement feeds what stands (the witnesses of Becoming.Resolution, refinement_feeds_witnesses), and hold with the refinement counted as a giving (World.rests_unrefuted_refinement_counted, World.arising_opens_refinement_counted) or with the unit fixed from some step on (Flow.taking_not_recurring); these are cited, not reproved. Law 2 concerns what holds, not amounts, and survives as stated. Need is read in the unit of the level, a commitment of the representation Ren decided on 12 October (condition r t > 0), not a premise on worlds; a reserve fed by the refinement may fall forever (Web.CarriesIn of Becoming.Resolution), and the laws of dependence counting a loss over a stretch likewise need the refinement counted as a giving. No premise is derived; no definition of Resolution is changed. The names (BalancesAtOn, RisesAt, FallsAt, RunsDownOnAt, Doubling) are the AI's.

- Doubling: the unit splits in two and nothing is exchanged, so every level doubles; every condition rises in raw counts while nothing changes in the unit and the total does not fall. So the law of one exchange is a law of change read in the unit. [Units.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Units.lean)
